messages:
Maria CS: Heads up 1 Silverpine asked for a renewal amendment: shorten to a 9-month extension, add 15 seats (prorated for 30 days), and have invoices issued to a different legal entity (Silverpine EU LTD). They9re insisting on a wet (ink) signature on the amendment. Can we accept a scanned copy as legally binding?

Aj Sales: Sounds doable but need to know on two things: 1) can finance accept invoices to the EU entity? 2) can legal live with a scanned wet-signed page + an email attestation from their GC? If yes, we can offer a one-time 10% discount on the seat add-on for the renewal.

Kevin Legal: Short answer: probably yes, with conditions. We need the amendment to contain an explicit acceptance/signature clause that allows scanned copies as evidence and a clear signature block (name, title, date). Also confirm whether the signer9s authority is documented. If they9re willing to courier originals later, that helps. Send me the proposed amendment and I9ll add the language.

Sophie Account: For billing we need the new entity9s registered name, VAT/tax ID and official address before reissuing or sending invoices. Also they must provide a PO that matches the billing entity. Net45 is ok but will require credit approval for a longer term on the account.

Maria CS: Customer said GC can email an attestation: "we confirm this scanned signature is a true copy of an original wet signature" and they9ll overnight the original if required. They also said VAT ID will be provided by EOD.

Aj Sales: Confirming we9ll ask AE to request: - VAT/tax id - PO referencing Silverpine EU LTD - scanned signed amendment + GC attestation email - courier tracking number if they ship originals

Kevin Legal: Add to my checklist: 1) signature page with printed name/title/date; 2) clause permitting electronic/scanned copy as legally effective evidence pending receipt of originals; 3) tax/withholding paragraph for EU invoicing; 4) statement about acceptance of originals within X days of scan. After draft I9ll confirm if we also need ID or notarization.

Sophie Account: Billing sample header request (send exactly like below so we map fields):

"BillingEntity: Silverpine EU LTD
Address: Avenida da Liberdade 45, 2Floor, Lisbon, PT-1250
VAT: PT-987654321
Currency: EUR
PaymentTerm: NET45"

Sophie Account: For proration: tell them to state start/end dates for the 30-day seat add-on window so we can compute a prorated invoice/credit.

Maria CS: I9ll chase the AE to collect VAT + PO + the scanned amendment + attestation and to ask about courier timing.

Iris Ops Bot: CRM reminder created for account=Silverpine, task=Renewal Amendment, owners=@Maria CS,@Aj Sales,@Sophie Account. Task ID: CR-89398.

Aj Sales: Drafting a one-page checklist for the customer on wet-sign workflow, will paste here for quick review: 1) Print amendment fully. 2) Sign entire signature block with ink (no initials). 3) Scan at 300dpi or phone capture in high quality and email to renewals@redwood.ai with subject: "Silverpine EU LTD 1 Signed Amendment". 4) GC to send a short attestation email in the body confirming scanned copy is true and signatory authority. 5) Mail original to Redwood Legal (if required we'll provide address).

Kevin Legal: Fine but add: include signer's printed ID name and title on the page. Note: compliance may request a copy of government ID if identity is unclear.

Maria CS: Great. Next steps: AE to upload VAT/PO + scanned amendment + GC attestation to the CRM task; Legal to review draft amendment; Billing waits for entity details to reissue invoice and to calculate proration. I9ll follow up tomorrow morning and close the loop.
